source_requirement: Build a Library Management System where librarians manage books, students borrow books, and admins manage users.

data.project_summary: Library Management System for librarians, students, and admins

features.name: User Management
features.description: Admins can create, edit, and delete user accounts

features.name: Book Management
features.description: Librarians can add, edit, and delete book records

features.name: Borrowing System
features.description: Students can borrow and return books, librarians can track borrowing history

features.name: Reporting and Analytics
features.description: Admins can generate reports on user activity and book borrowing trends

user_stories.benefit: Ensure secure and controlled access to the system

user_stories.goal: Manage book records and track borrowing history
user_stories.benefit: Efficiently manage library resources and optimize book availability
Access a wide range of books and resources for academic purposes

assumptions: Librarians have access to a database of book records
Students have a valid library account and PIN
Admins have the necessary permissions to manage user accounts
open_questions: How will we handle overdue book fines and penalties?
What is the process for adding new book titles to the system?
How will we ensure data security and integrity in the system?
